descriptionMarkdown:
This is Hyperion. The advanced version of my other ship NORAD II. This beast is capable of going to the Solar system edge and even further.

Needs nuclear input from the planet. Optionally does science as well. The planetary science packs are imported but up to the white science, all are produced on the ship. Has optional water barrel refill from planet if your water falls below reserves to give it a headstart.

Has some empty space for your other designs or for more electricity & fuel. Legendaries are mandatory I would say because it barely makes enough ammo for the travel.

I was at all weapon dmg & speeds lvl 12 research points when I finished the game with this.

Be sure to do smaller trips to closer planets first to fill up the ship. It takes A LOT OF TIME to get everything filled & ready to go
title: Hyperion - Solar System Edge
